title: GASS Records — a cigarette that burns down as you scroll
note: A fixed cigarette on the right edge works as the scroll-progress bar. It is two PNG slices, and the top slice slides down into the filter (translateY clamp 0–70%), so it gets shorter as you read. Two blurred smoke SVGs (mix-blend-screen) change opacity and skew with scroll speed. Swap the object and it is a fun, on-brand progress meter.
